select coalesce(lo.status,'?') status, coalesce(lo.cancel_reason,'') reason, count(*) n,
       min(lo.created_at)::text first_at, max(lo.created_at)::text last_at,
       round(avg(extract(epoch from now() - lo.created_at)/60)::numeric,0) avg_age_min,
       count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from fills f where f.kalshi_order_id = lo.kalshi_order_id)) any_fill,
       now()::text as now_at
from live_orders lo where lo.strategy = 'Hmmsell10' group by 1,2 order by 3 desc
